snippet.title: Yume Nikki Fangame playthrough - Trade Effluent ver. 0.00
snippet.description:
I played through the game twice to demonstrate the random nature of this game. The order of locations you visit throughout the game and the effects you collect are randomized. However, despite there being 11 total effects, you can only get 10 of them in a single run. I've checked. Upon my third attempt I got the last effect (Glitch) needed to see everything the game had to offer.

Content warning:
- Body horror
- Depiction of impalement

Read more about this fangame: https://ynfg.yume.wiki/Trade_Effluent
[Download unavailable]
Dream Diary Jam 2017 page: https://itch.io/jam/dream-diary-jam
